messages:
james: Alerting seems broken — incident-bot didn't page the on-call for the latency spike at 11:17 UTC. customers seeing 500s in US-WEST.
sasha: seeing the same in App Metrics, 5xx rate spiked ~11:16. paging channel empty.
michael: @james can you confirm incident-bot webhook delivered? I see webhook 200s from our side but no outbound to PagerFlow.
james: checking logs now. quick grep shows a 422 from /integrations/pagerflow at 11:17: `invalid_recipient_mapping`.
incident-bot: (automated) received alert id=ctx-9876, attempted dispatch to pagerflow, status=422. retry_policy=exponential.
sasha: hmm mapping change? Did we roll the oncall map yesterday? @ops-runbooks any config rotations? :thinking_face: 
ops-runbooks: we rotated signing keys for PagerFlow last night but kept mappings untouched. pushing query to infra team.
michael: as a mitigation, can someone manually page the oncall? run: `/page oncall ops` or fallback SMS. we should also create a manual incident channel.
james: paging oncall manually now via SMS. `paged: michael (oncall)`, awaiting ack.
ops-runbooks: infra confirms PagerFlow started rejecting requests with 422 when recipient_id has `null` in payload — looks like our mapping sync job failed to populate a new team id after recent org restructure.
sasha: ok plan: 1) manual pages + confirm ack 2) hotfix mapping sync job (ops) 3) add validation to incident-bot to surface missing recipient ids before sending 4) postmortem.
michael: manual page acked by oncall. customers still affected — routing layer showing ~12% error rate on generate endpoint. escalated to eng-runtime.
incident-bot: (automated) follow-up: alert severity escalated to P1 due to customer impact, if no ack in 5m will escalate to leadership.
james: ops, can you roll the sync job now? `kubectl rollout restart job/mapping-sync -n infra`. also enable verbose logging for mapping-sync.
ops-runbooks: mapping-sync job restarted, logs show failure to fetch org mapping from internal-iam: 503 from iam-service. working with iam on a rollback.
sasha: temporary workaround: incident-bot change: if recipient_id missing, route to `oncall-default` instead of failing. michael can you prodde a quick PR?
michael: pushing small PR to incident-bot to default to oncall-default when recipient missing. will request an urgent deploy to staging then prod if green.
ops-runbooks: iam team fixed the 503 issue — mapping-sync completed and recipient ids repopulated at 11:38.
james: incident-bot now sending pages again — pagerflow-bot shows deliveries. verifying no missed pages.
incident-bot: (automated) reconciled 3 queued alerts and delivered to `oncall-rotation`.
sasha: thanks. next steps: runbook update to capture mapping-sync checks, add alert for mapping-sync failures, and postmortem to capture customer impact & SLA exposure.
michael: adding actions to incident ticket: timeline, root cause, mitigation, and follow-ups. will include commands and PR links.
james: good work. tagging this thread for postmortem owners: @michael @sasha. closing live mitigation — transition to retro. :thumbsup:
